urdu: کیا 1986ء میں پروفیسر کیتھ ملر کی قیادت میں قراقرم ہمالیہ ریسرچ مہم کا رکن کون تھا؟
english: Who was a member of the Karakoram Himalaya Research Expedition led by Professor Keith Miller in 1986?
roman_1: Kya 1986 mein Professor Keith Miller ki qiyadat mein Karakoram Himalaya Research Mission ka rukun kon tha?
roman_2: Kia 1986 may Professor Keith Miller ke qiyadat mein Karakoram Himalaya Research Mission ka rukun kon tha?
roman_3: Kyaa 1986 mein Professor Keith Miller ki qiyadat mein Karakoram Himalaya Research Mission ka member kaun tha?
